+import pytest
+
+import sqlparse
+from sqlparse import sql, tokens as T
+
+
+def walk(node):
+    yield node
+    for child in getattr(node, 'tokens', ()):
+        yield from walk(child)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('tail', [
+    'order by a',
+    'limit 2',
+    'union select 2',
+    'union all select 2',
+    'except select 2',
+    'intersect select 2',
+])
+def test_qualify_boundaries(tail):
+    source = 'select a from t where a > 0 qualify a = 1 ' + tail
+    stmt, = sqlparse.parse(source)
+    assert str(stmt) == source
+    where = stmt.token_next_by(i=sql.Where)[1]
+    clause = stmt.token_next_by(i=sql.Qualify)[1]
+    assert str(where) == 'where a > 0 '
+    assert isinstance(clause, sql.Qualify)
+    assert str(clause) == 'qualify a = 1 '
+    assert clause.parent is stmt
+    assert clause.token_first().match(T.Keyword, 'QUALIFY')
+    for node in walk(stmt):
+        for child in getattr(node, 'tokens', ()):
+            assert child.parent is node
+
+
+def test_qualify_at_end():
+    source = 'select a from t qualify a = 1'
+    stmt, = sqlparse.parse(source)
+    assert isinstance(stmt.tokens[-1], sql.Qualify)
+    assert str(stmt.tokens[-1]) == 'qualify a = 1'
+    assert str(stmt) == source
+    assert stmt.get_type() == 'SELECT'
+
+
+def test_nested_qualify():
+    source = ('select * from (select a from t where a > 0 '
+              'qualify a = 1) q qualify b = 2 order by b')
+    stmt, = sqlparse.parse(source)
+    assert str(stmt) == source
+    clauses = [node for node in walk(stmt) if isinstance(node, sql.Qualify)]
+    assert len(clauses) == 2
+    assert sorted(str(node) for node in clauses) == [
+        'qualify a = 1', 'qualify b = 2 ']
+    inner = next(node for node in clauses if str(node) == 'qualify a = 1')
+    assert isinstance(inner.parent, sql.Parenthesis)
+    assert inner.parent.tokens[-1].match(T.Punctuation, ')')
+    assert isinstance(stmt.token_next_by(i=sql.Qualify)[1], sql.Qualify)
+    for node in walk(stmt):
+        for child in getattr(node, 'tokens', ()):
+            assert child.parent is node

Introduce a public sqlparse.sql.Qualify TokenList subclass and group each QUALIFY clause at both statement level and inside parentheses. Its range starts at QUALIFY and includes all following tokens up to, but not including, ORDER BY, LIMIT, UNION, UNION ALL, EXCEPT, or INTERSECT; whitespace before a terminating keyword remains in the clause. Without such a keyword, consume the rest of the current groupable token range, excluding enclosing parenthesis delimiters. Existing Where groups must stop before QUALIFY instead of swallowing it.
